categories.main_business_segments: Shibuya Corporation operates three main business segments: Packaging Plant Business (including bottling, capping, labeling, pharmaceutical, food processing, and regenerative medicine systems), Mechatronics System Business (including semiconductor manufacturing equipment, medical devices, cutting and ultrasonic equipment), and Agricultural Equipment Business (mainly sorting and grading systems for agricultural products).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced automation, computer-controlled high-speed packaging, aseptic filling technology, robotics, AI-based image processing, and precision mechatronics. It emphasizes proprietary technologies in aseptic PET bottle filling, automated cell culture systems, semiconductor bonding, and AI-driven agricultural sorting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include beverage, food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic manufacturers, as well as medical device OEMs and agricultural cooperatives. Major end markets are the beverage and food industry (especially for aseptic PET bottling), medical device manufacturers (notably for dialysis equipment), semiconductor producers, and agricultural organizations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in Japan, China, Southeast Asia (including Thailand and Malaysia), North America, and Europe. Japan remains the largest market, but overseas sales, especially in Asia and North America, are growing, supported by local subsidiaries and manufacturing bases.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shibuya Corporation is primarily a midstream and downstream supplier, providing integrated production systems, equipment, and automation solutions directly to manufacturers in the beverage, food, pharmaceutical, medical, semiconductor, and agricultural sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing world-leading ('Dantotsu') products, expanding into new markets and business domains, and promoting sustainability through energy/resource-saving solutions. R&D focuses on innovation in aseptic filling, regenerative medicine automation, AI/IoT-driven automation, and environmental technologies, with active industry-academia-government collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of large-scale production systems, equipment, and related engineering services. The company also earns from after-sales services, maintenance, and, to a lesser extent, OEM manufacturing and licensing of proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shibuya Corporation is a leading player in Japan's packaging and automation equipment industry, holding an estimated 80-90% domestic share in aseptic PET bottle filling systems. Key competitors include other global packaging and automation equipment manufacturers, but Shibuya differentiates itself through technological leadership and high market share in core niches.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending June 2025, consolidated sales reached 129.0 billion yen (up 11.8% YoY), with operating profit at 13.7 billion yen and net profit at 10.1 billion yen. The company has over 3,300 employees and targets further growth, aiming for 150 billion yen in sales by FY2027 and 200 billion yen by FY2030, driven by new products and global expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shibuya emphasizes its ability to deliver industry-leading, highly reliable, and innovative production systems that support customers' growth and sustainability goals. Its unique strengths include advanced aseptic filling technology, automation for regenerative medicine, AI-driven agricultural solutions, and a strong commitment to environmental and resource efficiency.
